newsitem.title: USA: Community sees acquisitions adding to EPS.
newsitem.headline: Community sees acquisitions adding to EPS.

text.p: Community Bank System Inc said Tuesday the 20 branches it bought from KeyCorp's KeyBank NA and Fleet Financial Group Inc's Fleet Bank will contribute to its earnings.
"There's absolutely no dilutive effect and we expect the branches to be accetive to earnings immediately," said chief executive Sanford Belden Tuesday in an interview.
Community said it closed the acquisition of eight Key branches in western New York June 16 and 12 Fleet branches in upstate New York July 18 for an undisclosed amount of preferred stock.

Belden said the branches would add about $315 million in deposits and $95 million in loans, increasing Community's assets to more than $1.6 billion from $1.5 billion as of June 30 and its network to 68 branches.
He added the bank holding company will close one of its Community Bank NA branches and two Key branches within 90 days, without any job losses.
Community posted a net income of $3.7 million, or $0.48 a share in the second quarter, compared with a $3.5 million net, or $0.46 a share, the year before.
The bank's stock traded at 28-1/2 Tuesday afternoon, down 1/4 but close to its 52-week high of 29.
